posts.title: How to Bypass Microsoft Account Sign-In in Windows 11 25H2 Setup
posts.description: During setup, Windows 11 25H2 normally requires Microsoft account sign-in, especially on Home and Pro editions. To install Windows 11 with a local account instead, press Shift + Fn + F10 at the Out-of-Box Experience (OOBE) sign-in screen and run: start ms-cxh:localonly This launches the local account creation flow from the OOBE screen.
